resources.string: A small stopwatch floats on top of any app. Show or hide it from the Quick Settings tile.
Swipe down twice from the top of the screen, tap the pencil (edit) icon, and drag the \"Stopwatch\" tile into the active tiles.
The first time you tap the tile, the settings screen opens. Turn on \"Display over other apps\" for QuickStopWatch, then tap the tile again.
Tap the tile to show the stopwatch. Tap it again to hide it. The screen stays on while the stopwatch is shown.
Tap the circle to start or pause. Drag it to move it. Hiding it resets the time to 00:00.
The stopwatch is not shown on the lock screen. Time keeps counting while the screen is off.
